title: A Terminal for the Signal
author: Silas Dravenmoor
blurb: Rosalind Fairweather, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
